constraints.ocl:
context Customer
inv: ((self.cart <> null) and (self.cart.oclIsTypeOf(Cart))) and (self.fullName.toLowerCase() = 'test')

context ReturnRequest
inv: (self.item.order = self.order) and (self.reason <> null)

context Customer
inv: (self.addresses->collect(x | x.postalCode)->notEmpty()) and (self.email <> '' and self.email.size() > 0)

context Coupon
inv: (self.orders->any(x | x.placedAt <> '') <> null) and (self.code.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')

context InventoryItem
inv: self.quantity >= 49 and self.quantity <= 94

context Payment
inv: self.amount >= 59 and self.amount <= 76

context Cart
inv: self.items->size() >= 3 and self.items->size() <= 3

context CartItem
inv: self.quantity >= 11 and self.quantity <= 88

context Product
inv: (self.reviews->collect(x | x.rating)->sum() >= 8) and (self.basePrice <> null)

context Cart
inv: (self.items->size() > 0) and (self.createdAt.size() >= 2 implies self.createdAt.substring(1, 2) = 'AB')

context ReturnRequest
inv: (self.order.customer.fullName <> '') and (self.requestedAt.size() >= 4 implies self.requestedAt.substring(1, 4) = 'AB')

context Product
inv: (self.reviews->notEmpty()) and (self.name <> '' and self.name.size() > 0)

context Coupon
inv: ((self.code <> '') and (self.orders->forAll(v | v.placedAt <> ''))) and (self.orders->exists(v | not(v.placedAt <> '')))

context Customer
inv: ((self.email <> '') and (self.addresses->forAll(v | v.city <> ''))) and (self.addresses->exists(v | not(v.city <> '')))

context Review
inv: ((self.product.store.name <> '') and (self.comment.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')) and (not((self.product.store.name <> '') and (self.comment.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')))

context Customer
inv: ((self.fullName <> '') and (self.orders->forAll(v | v.orderNo <> ''))) and (self.orders->exists(v | not(v.orderNo <> '')))

context Cart
inv: ((self.items->any(x | x.quantity >= 10) <> null) and (self.createdAt.size() = 44)) and (not((self.items->any(x | x.quantity >= 10) <> null) and (self.createdAt.size() = 44)))

context OrderItem
inv: (self.quantity mod 2 = 0) and (not(self.quantity mod 2 = 0))

context OrderItem
inv: (self.quantity mod 9 = 0) and (not(self.quantity mod 9 = 0))

context Store
inv: (self.products->exists(x | x.basePrice > 2)) and (not(self.products->exists(x | x.basePrice > 2)))

context Product
inv: ((self.variants->collect(x | x.priceDelta)->sum() >= 5) and (self.variants->any(x | x.priceDelta > 0) <> null)) and (not((self.variants->collect(x | x.priceDelta)->sum() >= 5) and (self.variants->any(x | x.priceDelta > 0) <> null)))

context OrderItem
inv: (self.quantity mod 5 = 0) and (not(self.quantity mod 5 = 0))

context Customer
inv: ((self.customerId <> '') and (self.orders->forAll(v | v.orderNo <> ''))) and (self.orders->exists(v | not(v.orderNo <> '')))

context Store
inv: ((self.coupons->collect(x | x.orders)->size() >= 2) and (self.products->size() = 3)) and (self.products->size() <> 3)
